legendEntries.label: Diagnostic — routes you to the right production sequence
Curricular — the order a person learns the skills

nodes.label: ONTOLOGICAL
nodes.note: Social Action Tetrahedron · BGTE · Optimum Sequence · AIC.  —  Not performed. A claim about how persons, ideals, orgs and actions necessarily relate, and about what makes their relating come to good. You check yourself against it and find which relation has failed.

nodes.label: DIAGNOSTIC
nodes.note: Systemic Problem Solving · Cynefin · Six Nested Questions · Six Thinking Hats · DSRP.  —  A routing procedure. Takes an unclear situation and returns a type, a scale, and a decision about which production sequence to enter. The kind people most need and the kind least often written down.

nodes.label: PRODUCTION
nodes.note: 15 Ps · Another Sequence of Tools · Vester SensiMod · System Discovery Process.  —  Ordered work with resources, handoffs and deliverables. Looks like conventional method documentation and is the least transferable — each is fitted to a domain.

nodes.label: CURRICULAR
nodes.note: The six pathways already named in the SODOTO Skills Registry, plus the Systems Curriculum's four levels.  —  A learning progression is not a work progression. CLD then Stock Flow then System Dynamics then Vester is how you ACQUIRE the practice; nobody would run a project in that order. This is the kind SODOTO actually certifies.

edges.label: checks
edges.note: A diagnostic run that passes its own steps but fails Beauty, Good, Truth or Economy has not succeeded.

edges.label: checks
edges.note: Production work that is efficient and ugly, or effective and untrue to its ecology, fails here regardless of delivery.

edges.label: checks
edges.note: What gets taught is what gets repeated. A curriculum that transmits skill without the governing models propagates harm faster.

edges.label: ROUTES_TO
edges.note: The conditional branch. Cynefin's typing selects which production sequence is entered — complicated goes one way, complex another. This is why ROUTES_TO is a third relation and not containment.

edges.label: qualifies
edges.note: Transmissibility, not confidence. Whether anyone present is certified in the skills this pathway needs — read off the SODOTO registry's Active / Ready / Candidate.

edges.label: qualifies
edges.note: A production pathway whose skills have no mentor can be run by its author and nobody else. That is a skill, not a method.

edges.label: Posterity → new pattern
edges.note: Step 16 of the 15 Ps. A finished production run abstracts what is universal and publishes it, which adds a teachable skill back into the registry. This is how the shelf grows.
